title: Introduction and overview — Porsche 550 Spyder (1953-1956)
description: Introduction and overview of the Porsche 550 Spyder (1953-1956): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Porsche 550 Spyder was Porsche's first pure racing car: a 1.5-liter four-cam flat-four in a 1,200-lb spyder body. It won its class at Le Mans and the Carrera Panamericana.
